r4.why: First systematic study (26), definition via bijections closed under composition/inverse (27), Sn (28), Cayley left regular representation (29).

r5.why: Matrix/linear groups definition (33-34), action on K^n (35), transformation groups preserving structure, set vs vector space (37-38).

r6.why: Action approach (30), An simple for n>=5 (31), radicals (32), classification >10,000 pages 1960-2004 (9).
